text:
maya: Heads up — Q4 capacity forecast looks riskier. We're seeing sustained context-length growth and a higher streaming vs non-streaming mix. Need a quick GPU-hour projection and mitigations.

sam: baseline numbers? token uplift?

maya: baseline is ~120k GPU-hours/month (A100/H100 pool). Observed token-per-request +35% last month; streaming % of requests up to 18%. If trend continues, expect 30–45% GPU-hour increase in peak windows. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

indra: Streaming is worse than it looks — small incremental outputs reduce batch width and break KV reuse. Long-context streaming increases KV cache residency and memory pressure. We hit an OOM on an H100 in eu-west-1 this morning.

lee: saw the alert at 08:12. Autoscaler failed to acquire more H100s because region quota was exhausted. Took ~22m to failover some jobs to us-west. :rotating_light:

opsbot: Incident created: INC-20240306-0812 — autoscaler blocked by regional quota in eu-west-1 (assigned to eng-infra).

carla: finance — what's the estimated cost impact if we hit a 35% token growth sustained? Need figures for exec planning.

sam: very quick calc (conservative):
```
current_gpu_hours = 120000
proj_multiplier = 1.35  # conservative scenario
projected_gpu_hours = 162000
delta_hours = 42000
blended_rate_per_gpu_hour = $3.5  # blended reserved/ondemand mix estimate
estimated_delta_cost = delta_hours * 3.5  # ~ $147k/month
```
This excludes inefficiency penalty from poor batching/kv churn, which could push effective cost 10–25% higher.

maya: mitigation options (prioritized):
- reserve 50 A100s in us-west for Q4 to cover peak traffic (fast to provision, helps failover).
- implement aggressive KV cache eviction for streaming sessions > 8k tokens.
- add routing rules to send long-context workloads to H100-large-memory pool, short streaming to L4s.
- push quantized 4-bit variants for long-context models to reduce GPU-hour per token.
- introduce a streaming QoS tier (rate-limited) for free-tier users to keep production SLOs.

indra: technical notes: eviction policy needs careful tuning — evicting too early causes recompute of past KV and increases tokens processed. We should prototype an LRU window plus sampling to identify cold sessions. I'll put a canary in staging: config snippet below.

```yaml
kv_cache:
  max_entries: 2500000
  eviction_policy: lru_window
  lru_window_size: 8192  # tokens
  sample_eviction_rate: 0.05
```

lee: region constraints: eu-west quotas are tight this quarter. We should pre-submit quota increases with cloud provider now; also prepare routing policy to failover non-EU data to us-central/us-west for asynchronous jobs. Sync-heavy EU customers need exceptions + approval.

carla: if we reserve 50 A100s, what's the booking vs on-demand delta (ballpark)? we need CAPEX/OPEX numbers.

sam: rough: reserved units ~30% cheaper vs on-demand. Ballpark monthly cost for 50 A100s reserved ~ $75k–$95k depending on term and discount; on-demand would be ~ $110k–$130k. Net monthly saving ~ $30k–$40k. I'll add a sensitivity table in the forecast sheet.

maya: can we also get a throughput projection (tokens/sec and requests/sec) for the 10/30/50% token-growth scenarios? want to present to product planning.

sam: will produce three scenarios (10% / 30% / 50% token growth) with GPU-hours, peak throughput, expected P95 latency impact, and budget delta. Dropping updated sheet by EOD.

indra: I'll prototype the eviction + routing canary tomorrow and run a load test with a mixed streaming/non-streaming workload to measure batching degradation.

lee: I'll open the quota request ticket with cloud and add fallback routes to the router config. Also adding alert rules for KV-memory > 75% in eu-west.

maya: next steps summary: sam = forecast updates + sensitivity table; indra = eviction/routing canary; lee = quota + failover; carla = budget sign-off options. Thanks. cc @product-planning

sam: noted — will include recommended reserve count and a cost/perf breakeven for Q4.

indra: small note — streaming telemetry currently undercounts `tokens_generated` for partial-chunk streaming; I'll patch the recorder so the forecast numbers are accurate.

maya: perfect. let's reconvene after the spreadsheet lands. :thumbsup:
